items.a: Most companies start using Norka ERP within a few weeks. Custom software is planned with you up front, with weekly releases you can test.
Yes. Everything we build works fully in Arabic and English, including right-to-left screens and printed documents.

items.a: Each company's data is separate, and permissions decide exactly who sees what. Norka AI runs as a private instance for each company.
